input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only cap is one-way: it limits TrueLink to 12 months' hosting/support compensation while Client's liability (including under the very broad Section 12(a) indemnity) is unlimited, which is walk-away territory under our playbook. There is also no mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and no statement that Client's payment obligations sit outside the cap. We added a mirrored cap on Client plus a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, deliberately leaving the scope of TrueLink's own cap untouched.

input.quote: TrueLink shall indemnify and hold Client harmless, its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, agents and licensors harmless from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses, and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to any
input.rationale: TrueLink's indemnity is limited to claims arising from its own breach or performance failure and does not cover third-party IP infringement by the Interface or hosted site (there is no non-infringement warranty either), nor its breach of law, data incidents or gross negligence — so it fails the fallback, while Client's indemnity in 12(a) is unusually broad. We added the standard IP, breach-of-law, data-incident and gross negligence/wilful misconduct prongs.
